ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.76 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) for the unexempted 1.96 km off-route segment, and record the RD-1 route violation on the driver's file.
ruling.reasoning:
RydeTAXI trip, Tanjong Pagar Centre → Changi Airport T3, 18:35–19:10, meter total $47.97 [F6]. The GPS record shows one off-route segment 18:46–18:52 covering 3.50 km against an optimal 1.54 km, +1.96 km and straying up to 752 m from the optimal route [F3]; under RD-1 that segment is a deviation unless RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 excuses it, and no threshold applies [RD-1].

RD-4 is the driver's only plausible excuse, and it fails. The incident screen is ✗: the sole feed entry, the 18:27 ECP vehicle-breakdown notice, is a lane-1 advisory ("Avoid lane 1") 0 m from the optimal route [F11], which does not account for a 752 m excursion [F3]; and the corridor records show ECP and Airport Boulevard at band 5 (40–49 km/h) throughout 18:19–19:15 [F9][F10] — free-moving traffic, not the band 1–2 severe congestion RD-4 contemplates, and band data cannot exempt a segment on its own [RD-4(b)]. The driver's post-trip assertion of "a breakdown on the route, the whole road was slow" [F8] is therefore uncorroborated for the replaced stretch, so RD-4(c) sends the segment back to RD-2 [RD-4][F8][F9][F11].

No consent exists: the chat record is empty, and the only message is the driver's own statement written after the trip [F7][F8], which under RD-5/G11 is not rider consent. With no rider message at all before the segment, this is the "consent_after_or_none" ground and the segment counts [RD-5]. RD-3 likewise gives nothing: the trace records no measured rider stop, so there is no rider-named place to exempt the way there [RD-3].

Amount: this is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so the unexempted segment's extra km run straight into the fare at this trip's per-km rate, $33.33 ÷ 23.64 km = $1.4099/km [F3][F6][RD-2]. 1.96 km × $1.4099/km = $2.7634 → $2.76. The residual billed excess (2.17 km / $3.06 [F4] less the 1.96 km segment) is corridor/matching noise within the 200 m band, which RD-2 does not refund [RD-2]. No ERP/toll or unpublished add-on appears in the breakdown, so FARE-1 adds nothing [F6][RD-2][FARE-1].

RD-6 does not fire: driver profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F14], so no account flag attaches, consistent with the ✗ trace element [RD-6].

segment_findings.reason: The chat record contains no rider-driver messages, and the only message is the driver's own post-trip statement [F7][F8]; there is no rider message sent before the 18:46 segment start agreeing to this route, so under RD-5 the segment is not excused and the 1.96 km extra counts under RD-2. No rider-named stop is recorded either (RD-3).

rejected_claims.reason: Accepted as to the measurement of the segment but rejected as framed: the deviation is established under RD-1, yet the driver's RD-4 excuse was the live question, and it fails because the ECP band-5 corridor record [F9][F10] and the lane-1-only breakdown notice [F11] do not corroborate a 752 m excursion [F3] under RD-4.

Substantially accepted but its 'free-flowing' gloss is rejected: F9/F10 read band 5 = 40–49 km/h, degraded but moving — the point against the driver is that it is not band 1–2 severe congestion as RD-4(b) requires, not that the road was free-flowing [F9][F10].

Rejected: the 18:27 ECP breakdown notice [F11] is a lane-1 advisory 0 m from the optimal route and does not explain a detour straying up to 752 m [F3]; the corridor was running at band 5 [F9][F10], so RD-4(a) cover does not attach [RD-4].

Rejected: RD-4(a) requires the incident to justify the replaced stretch, and the trace marks the incident screen ✗; F11 does not place the breakdown on the replaced section of the optimal route in any way that accounts for the driven path [F3][F11][RD-4].
Rejected as an excuse: the absence of chat [F7] means there was no rider consent at all, and the driver's post-trip statement [F8] cannot supply consent under RD-5/G11 [RD-5].
Rejected as to the outcome: the arithmetic of the excess charge is correct [F4], but the 1.96 km segment is unexempt for the reasons above, so the refund is not $0 and no_action is wrong [F3][RD-2].
Accepted as to RD-6 only: with route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F14] no account flag attaches; that does not defeat the RD-1/RD-2 refund, which turns on the unexcused segment [F14][RD-2][RD-6].
